findings.title: Billed ICU days contradict discharge summary narrative
findings.detail: The hospital bill charges for 3 days in the ICU and 1 day in the ward, but the discharge summary states that the patient was shifted to the ward on day 2 of admission.

quotes.quote: Shifted to the ward on day 2 of admission and remained stable in the ward until discharge.

findings.title: Pharmacy bill date precedes discharge prescription
findings.detail: The outside pharmacy invoice is dated 18 Oct 2024, predating the discharge prescription for the same medications which was issued on 19 Oct 2024.
